# The Jae Rich Project

The Jae Rich Project is a live music duo serving Florida's Emerald Coast with soulful vocals, guitar, and covers spanning rock, soul, pop, funk, Motown, and Top 40.

## Links

- [Canonical site](https://jaerichent.com/)
- [Upcoming performance dates](https://jaerichent.com/#dates)
- [Booking and contact](https://jaerichent.com/#contact)
- Virtual tip jar: linked from the canonical site

The DJ Requests interface appears only during configured performance windows. The public repertoire catalog is intentionally unavailable.
